Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Davao accountant can’t confirm own signature, tests senator-judges’ patience

blocks.text: Defense witness and Davao City Accountant Vingelin Bajan seems to have tested the patience of both the prosecution and the senator-judges, during the 41st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

items: Sandiganbayan suspends Martin Romualdez over plunder case

blocks.text: The anti-graft court Sandiganbayan 3rd Division suspends Leyte congressman and former House speaker Martin Romualdez for 90 days.

items: DOJ orders filing of cyber libel case vs Topacio, 5 others over Hontiveros complaint

blocks.text: The Department of Justice orders cyber libel cases to be filed against lawyer Ferdinand Topacio and five other pro-Duterte personalities.

items: Pax Silica signing eyed by year-end, not during ASEAN Summit – DTI

blocks.text: The Department of Trade and Industry says the Philippines will not yet sign on to Pax Silica during the ASEAN Summit, happening in Manila from November 15 to 18.

items: Alex Eala records new career-high world No. 15, lands as Asia’s 2nd best

blocks.text: Yet another career high for Alex Eala as she climbs to world no. 15, and the second-best in Asia. – Rappler.com
